topic: API data requests for dwell time and traffic
summary_markdown:
The discussion revolves around potential enhancements to the Data API regarding location analytics. Two main topics were raised:

1. **Dwell Time:** Currently, data is provided as a daily average in 5-minute intervals (e.g., 0-5, 5-10). A request was made to receive dwell time by hour instead of 5-minute intervals, and clarification was sought on whether this requires development work or if it is currently available.
2. **Unique Traffic:** Currently, only non-unique traffic per day is provided. The team inquired about the feasibility of calling unique traffic data for specific locations over a defined period via the API.

A methodological question regarding dwell time was also addressed: If a person arrives at 08:58 and leaves at 09:01, the system counts this session in the preceding hour (08:00-08:59).

Additionally, questions were raised about the methodology and confidence level of the data model over time.
decisions: The team will schedule a call on Monday to discuss API enhancements.
